A statement such as `user.name;` or `count + 1;` computes a value and throws it away. It is usually a mistake: a call without its `()`, a `===` that was meant to be `=`, or a line left behind after an edit.

Calls, `new`, assignments, `await`, `delete`, `void`, `import()`, and directives such as `"use strict"` do something, so they are not reported. The rule looks through `as`, `!`, and type arguments, so `save as unknown;` is reported like `save;`.

This rule is on by default in TypeScript files.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 4} */}
```ts
declare const user: { name?: string; save(): void };

user.save;
user.name === "admin";
user?.name;
user.name!;
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
declare const user: { name?: string; save(): void };

user.save();
user.name = "admin";
user?.save();
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowShortCircuit` | `false` | Allow `a && b()`, `a \|\| b()`, and `a ?? b()`, if the right side would be allowed as a statement. |
| `allowTernary` | `false` | Allow `a ? b() : c()`, if both branches would be allowed as statements. |
| `allowTaggedTemplates` | `false` | Allow a tagged template such as `` sql`...` `` as a statement. |
| `enforceForJSX` | `false` | Also report a JSX element as a statement. |
| `ignoreDirectives` | `false` | Allow strings at the start of a file or a function when `ecmaVersion` is 3, which has no directives. |

With `allowShortCircuit`, you can use `&&` in place of an `if`:

{/* good {"options": [{"allowShortCircuit": true}]} */}
```ts
declare const user: { save(): void } | undefined;

user && user.save();
```

The right side still has to do something:

{/* bad {"options": [{"allowShortCircuit": true}]} */}
```ts
declare const user: { save(): void } | undefined;

user && user.save;
```

{/* good {"options": [{"allowTernary": true}]} */}
```ts
declare const user: { isNew: boolean; create(): void; update(): void };

user.isNew ? user.create() : user.update();
```

{/* good {"options": [{"allowTaggedTemplates": true}]} */}
```ts
declare function sql(strings: TemplateStringsArray): void;

sql`DELETE FROM sessions`;
```

{/* bad {"options": [{"enforceForJSX": true}]} */}
```tsx
<p>Saved</p>;
```
